comment: 9 creature types. 'color' drives the placeholder card colour. 'rarity' controls hatch odds via balance.json's typeRarityWeights — common types hatch far more often than rare, and mythic (Aether only, for now) rarer still. Effectiveness is a data table: multiplier applied when 'attacker' type hits 'defender' type. 2 = strong, 0.5 = weak, 1 = neutral. Not used in slice 1 gameplay yet, but stored here so battles can read it later. Design note for whoever builds battles: rarity should not simply mean 'stronger' — a common-type creature should still be able to beat a rare/mythic one on skill/build; rarity should show up as better base stats and better special attacks on the species that roll those types, not as a hard combat trump. Aether has no effectiveness entries yet (neutral to everything) — deliberately left undefined until battles are designed, rather than guessed at now.
